sources.note: Official site identifies the active family winery, its own wine brands including Ribamar, and Caves Visconde de Salreu as a storage cellar acquired by the same producer; the current site offers no remote ordering mechanism.
Current contact page publishes the Azenhas do Mar address, GPS, phone, email and visit hours, with contact request only and no order channel.
Wine route lists Adega Beira Mar as a current Colares producer with an on-site shop.

notes: The two discovery entries were resolved into this single productive identity: Ribamar is a house brand and Caves Visconde de Salreu is a secondary cellar, neither a separate producer row.
